article.title: Penalty for contravention of section 62A.
article.content:
182B1[Penalty] for contravention of section 62A.

Section 182B  ·  Chapter XIII  ·  page 102 of the Act
Whoever contravenes the provisions of section 62A, shall be 2[liable for a penalty] which shall not be less than five thousand rupees, but may extend to ten thousand rupees.]
1 Subs. by Act 8 of 2026, s. 2 and Sch., for “Punishment” (w.e.f. 15-8-2026).
2 Subs. by s. 2 and Sch., ibid., for “punishable with fine” (w.e.f. 15-8-2026).
